bible_verses.english: To you, Yahweh, do I lift up my soul.
My God, I trust in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
I lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, today I lift up my soul to You, surrendering every worry and desire into Your care. You are my refuge, and I put my whole trust in Your unfailing love. Please steady my heart when doubts arise and guide my steps in Your truth. May I walk confidently today, knowing that in You, I am never forgotten or abandoned. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming or uncertain, this gentle echo of Psalm 25 reminds us where to place our trust. Lifting our souls to God is an intentional act of surrender, handing over our anxieties, fears, and hopes into His gentle hands. As we sing these scripture words together, we are anchored in the assurance that our Lord is faithful and will never let us be put to shame. Today, invite your heart to rest completely in His loving presence.
